meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: Claude 会把工作拆成极细的步骤:先按参考文档登记目标和每条成功标准,再用 ulw-loop CLI 把每步写入 .omo/ulw-loop 状态并做检查点;上下文丢失后先读目标与台账再续跑,不重新规划。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、ulw,或需要带检查点的长期目标执行、以证据为主的工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 做这个重构,先登记目标再拆步骤
say.note: 会先建目标并写入检查点状态

say.text: 继续上次的 ulw-loop,先读状态再接着做
say.note: 重读目标与台账后续跑

say.text: 给这个任务建 ulw-loop,每步都要有可验证证据

howto.what_en: Claude breaks the work into ultra-granular steps, registers goals and success criteria up front, and tracks each step in .omo/ulw-loop CLI state with checkpoints. After context loss it re-reads goals and ledger, then resumes.
howto.when_en: Use it when the user asks for ulw-loop, ulw, or durable checkpointed goal execution with evidence-led work.

say_en.text: Start a ulw-loop for this refactor and register the goal first
say_en.note: It creates the goal and writes checkpoint state

say_en.text: Resume the last ulw-loop: read the state first, then continue
say_en.note: Re-reads goals and ledger, then resumes

say_en.text: Set up a ulw-loop for this task with evidence for every step
